meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye ₹700 ke andar **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** sabse practical choice hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads, oily skin ya active pimples hain. Iski listed price lagbhag ₹521 hai.[1]

**Kaise use karein:**
- Raat mein face wash ke baad **2–3 drops**, pehle hafte mein 2 baar.
- Irritation na ho to alternate nights use karein.
- Uske baad moisturiser; din mein **SPF 30+ sunscreen** zaroor.
- Iske saath same routine mein retinol, AHA/BHA ya strong vitamin C na lagayein.

Agar skin sensitive hai ya acne ke saath redness/marks zyada hain, to **5% niacinamide serum** gentler option hai; The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide lagbhag ₹222 mein listed hai.[1] Salicylic acid aur niacinamide ko ek saath shuru karne ke bajay pehle ek hi active try karein.[1]

Deep, painful acne, pus wale pimples ya scarring ho to serum ke bajay dermatologist se consult karein. Prices offers ke saath badal sakti hain.
